rca_of_the_issue: The original bug was in _handle_checkout_completed (payments.py line 303-326). The webhook handler was converting trials (setting is_trial=false, trial_status='converted') whenever checkout.session.completed fired, regardless of payment_status. This meant users who abandoned checkout or had unpaid sessions still got converted to paid status. The fix adds a gate: trial conversion only fires when data.get('payment_status') == 'paid'. Bob's account was restored to trial state by the main agent.
